claims.citation: New York Herald, 23 July 1866, p. 3, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Malta (Br), Macaulay, Liverpool July 10, and
Queenstown 11th, with mdse and 551 passengers, to E Cu-
nard. July 15, exchanged signals with an Inman steamer,
bound E; 18th, bark A H Stevens, bound W; 21st, at 11 AM,
steamship City of Cork, bound E.
